_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Anti-Tamper Plan
summary: Specifies the format and content preparation instructions for an Anti-Tamper (AT) Plan documenting the lifecycle planning, design, verification, and validation of AT architecture and implementation to protect Critical Program Information.
use_relationship:
The Anti-Tamper (AT) Plan documents the lifecycle planning, design and verification and validation of AT architecture and implementation from concept development through final product performance evaluation and through sustainment.  The plan enables the program to make informed decisions to plan for and address the protection of Critical Program Information (CPI).

a. The AT Plan, when complete, will also consist of an AT Verification Plan which contains information related to the verification and validation of the AT architecture and design.

b. This Data Item Description (DID) contains format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Initial and Final AT Plan shall be submitted in the AT Plan Template format.  The Concept AT Plan can be submitted in contractor format. Plans requiring the use of the AT Plan Template will only be accepted in the most up-to-date format found on the AT Executive Agent website at https://at.dod.mil. The AT Plan shall conform to the following:

children.title: The report and all attachments
children.content: The report and all attachments shall be typewritten, or otherwise clearly lettered, and shall be duplicated using non-fading ink.

children.title: Text shall be prepared on standard
children.content: Text shall be prepared on standard letter size paper (8 1/2 x 11").

children.title: Additional attachments shall be fully identified
children.content: Additional attachments shall be fully identified, referenced in the text, and folded to conform to the size paper used in the report.

children.title: Security classification and distribution markings
children.content: Security classification and distribution markings shall conform to the requirements of the contract, purchase description and security requirements checklist, as applicable.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The AT Plan shall contain the following:

children.title: AT Verification Plan
children.content: (to be included as part of the AT Plan as appropriate).

children.title: Any additional attachments that may be included
children.content: Any additional attachments that may be included as part of the AT Plan as updated throughout the product's lifecycle.
